The '''ST2 concussion missile tube''' was a [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|concussion missile launcher]] manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. The launcher had a magazine of four [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]], typically Arakyd's [[ST2 concussion missile/Legends|ST2 concussion missile]]. The price of 1,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] made it popular with independent [[Starship/Legends|starship]] owners. The [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] was equipped with a pair of ST2 concussion missile racks located between the forward mandibles.<ref name="EGWT" />
